params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs:
Obtain scheduled, outgoing payments for a specific account.

Obsolete versions: [v1](includes/obsolete/get-scheduled-payments-for-account-v1.html).

params.name: product-category
params.description: Used to filter results on the _productCategory_ field applicable to accounts. Any one of the valid values for this field can be supplied. If absent then all accounts returned.

params.name: open-status
params.description: Used to filter results according to open/closed status. Values can be `OPEN`, `CLOSED` or `ALL`. If absent then `ALL` is assumed.

params.name: is-owned
params.description: Filters accounts based on whether they are owned by the authorised customer. `true` for owned accounts, `false` for unowned accounts and absent for all accounts.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs:

info.name: Get Scheduled Payments For Specific Accounts

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs:
Obtain scheduled payments for a specified list of accounts.

Obsolete versions: [v1](includes/obsolete/get-scheduled-payments-for-specific-accounts-v1.html).

params.name: accountId
params.description: The _accountId_ to obtain data for. _accountId_ values are returned by account list endpoints.

params.name: plan-status
params.description:
Allows for the filtering of plans based on their schedule status:
  • `ACTIVE` requests plans where one or more scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `false`,
  • `INACTIVE` requests plans where all scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `true`,
  • `ALL` requests all `ACTIVE` and `INACTIVE` plans.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs: Obtain instalment plans for a single specified account. The response **MUST** be ordered by plan _creationDate_ in descending order. If _isInstalmentDetailAvailable_ was specified as `true` for the provided _accountId_ but no plans match the provided parameters, an empty array **MUST** be returned. If _isInstalmentDetailAvailable_ was specified as `false` for the provided _accountId_, then the endpoint **MAY** respond with [404 - Resource Not Implemented](#error-404-resource-not-implemented).

params.name: plan-status
params.description:
Allows for the filtering of plans based on their schedule status:
  • `ACTIVE` requests plans where one or more scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `false`,
  • `INACTIVE` requests plans where all scheduled instalments have _isPaid_ equal to `true`,
  • `ALL` requests all `ACTIVE` and `INACTIVE` plans.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination).

items.docs: Obtain instalment plans for multiple accounts. The response **MUST** be ordered by plan _creationDate_ in descending order. If instalments are not supported for any account type, the endpoint **MAY** respond with [404 - Resource Not Implemented](#error-404-resource-not-implemented).
